answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the jetty of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The pulse is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
